checks.title: Desktop pipe exists: owner = Broker SID, DACL = Broker + one Control Plane ACE 0x00120083, served from the Broker process in session 0
Control Plane: a view session on the inner VM is accepted
Control Plane: a capture over that session returns a valid PNG (signature, IHDR of the asked size, IEND) of the inner VM screen
Control Plane: an act open that names operation lab-bd-act-1 and generation 1 is refused with the fixed denied reply while no task.start claim has been recorded
Other caller token: unrestricted, member of Hyper-V Administrators, exactly SeChangeNotifyPrivilege (so a refusal is not for want of the group)
evidence: token read from: the shim report of the other caller service

checks.title: A caller that is not the Control Plane (member of Hyper-V Administrators) gets no session: refused by the pipe DACL or by the peer check

MEASURED: the Control Plane may open the Broker service process (PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION) and read its image; the hash it computes is the SHA-256 of the Broker file. The helper needs this to pin imageSha256
evidence: denied = the helper cannot pin the Broker image from this identity: bh_view_open and bh_view_capture then end with server_identity_unavailable

checks.title: Control Plane, REAL helper in desktop mode (service identity, imageSha256 = the Broker file): a view session on the inner VM is accepted
evidence: image pin: the Broker file, sha256 ddc0d9fb89d2c07eca20d57c7caa65c4eb626f46fc109d0929ec1dfe391ee943

checks.title: Control Plane, REAL helper (service identity + imageSha256): a 640x480 capture over that session returns a valid PNG (signature, IHDR of the asked size, IEND)
CONTROL: the same helper without imageSha256 (service identity only): a view open and a capture are accepted. Tells a failed image pin apart from a failed helper path

Control Plane, REAL helper: an imageSha256 that is not the hash of the Broker file is refused with server_identity_mismatch before anything is sent (server_identity_unavailable = the image could not be read, so the comparison was never reached: BLOCKED)
evidence: image pin: the helper file, sha256 fa51d12cdc56a7010fafd6abeb2cf1c3c0b45d440e0c1df565b0c5df4af0ea26 (a real hash that is not the Broker one)

checks.title: Control Plane: fence, a receipt v2 (guest.command / task.start) signed with the lab key and sent by the helper is claimed (state UNKNOWN, action task.start, not a replay)
Control Plane: after that claim the same act open (operation lab-bd-act-1, generation 1) is accepted
Control Plane: in that act session a keyboard input (tap Shift) is accepted
MEASURED: the same session, mouse input (move, button 1 down, button 1 up). The inner VM has no OS: the synthetic mouse call is expected to fail (32768) and the Broker to answer denied
evidence: known on an inner VM without an OS: refused_reply, because the synthetic mouse call fails with 32768 (a Broker log would say input_failed)

checks.title: Control Plane: an act open for operation lab-bd-act-1 with generation 2 (the lease is generation 1) is refused with the fixed denied reply
Control Plane, REAL helper (service identity + imageSha256): after the task.start claim an act session for operation lab-bd-act-1, generation 1 is accepted
Control Plane, REAL helper (service identity + imageSha256): in that act session a keyboard input (tap Shift) is accepted
CONTROL: the same act open and keyboard input through the helper without imageSha256 (service identity only)
Control Plane: a second task.start claim (operation lab-bd-act-2) is recorded while a first act session is open, and the Broker ends that session with the fixed denied frame
Control Plane: the second lease (lab-bd-act-2, generation 2) opens an act session; after the Broker service is restarted the same open is refused (the lease lived in memory)
